simple.meaning: שַׁעֲרוּרָה (shaʻărûwrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something fearful.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Jeremiah 5:30. The surrounding context includes prophetic witness, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁעֲרוּרָה (H8186) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שַׁעֲרוּרָה (shaʻărûwrâh) / H8186 is traced through Jeremiah 5:30, Jeremiah 18:13, Jeremiah 23:14, Hosea 6:10 with generated occurrence evidence.
